body.name: \(\mathcal E_{n,\alpha}\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal E_{n,\alpha}=\{(p_x)_{x\in\mathcal X}\in\mathcal P_{n,\alpha}\}\cap\bigcap_{x\in\mathcal X}\{\max_{(s,t)\in\mathcal D_n}|\widehat F_{x,n}(s,t)-F_x(s,t)|\le\rho^F_{x,n}\}\cap\bigcap_{x\in\mathcal X}\{\max_{(s,t)\in\mathcal D_n}|\widehat G_{x,n}(s,t)-G_x(s,t)|\le\rho^G_{x,n}\}\).
